{{Quote|Please accept my assurances that General Parnell is making every effort to locate Ire Eleazari.''"<br />"''I hope so, if the Empire wishes a base on Ithor, my herd must never learn the truth about Ire's disgrace.|Oosea talking with an Imperial colonel|<ref name="JH" />}}
'''Oosea''' was a male [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. Unknown to the rest of his herd, he began cooperating with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With his cooperation, the Imperials began plans to create a base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. When Oosea was discovered, he framed his fellow Ithorian [[Ire Eleazari]]. Eleazari was banished from the herd after being framed, but worked with the [[Erling Tredway]] to clear his name.
